tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search the ShelfClub book catalog by title or author name. Returns up to 10 books, each with its ShelfClub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and mood, vibe, pace and genre tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book).

query.description: A book title, an author name, or both.

tools.name: find_books_by_mood
tools.description: Find books in the ShelfClub catalog by mood, vibe, pace and genre tags. At least one tag is needed. Books that carry every requested tag are listed first, most read first; when there are fewer of those than asked for, books that carry some of the tags follow, and `matchAll` says how many of the books returned carry every tag. Each book is returned with its own tags. Returns up to 10 books, each with its ShelfClub id, authors, description, reader rating, series and shelfclub.app link. The tags are machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book.

moods.description: How the book feels to read.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Look up one book in the ShelfClub catalog, by its ShelfClub id or by ISBN. Returns its description, authors, reader rating, series, an edition (ISBN, page count, publisher, publication date, language), its shelfclub.app link, and its mood, vibe, pace and genre tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book). A lookup by id also returns the ShelfClub author id of each author that has an author record, and which of the moods, vibes and pace readers of the book voted for, with how many did. These tools do not return content warnings: if asked, say so, and do not infer them from the tags or present anything as ShelfClub's.

id.description: The ShelfClub id of the book, as the other tools return it. Give this or `isbn`, not both.

isbn.description: An ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, with or without hyphens.

tools.name: get_similar_books
tools.description: List the books in the ShelfClub catalog whose mood, vibe, pace and genre tags overlap most with those of a given book, chosen from its 10,000 most-read books. The tags are machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book, and a book that has none has no similar books. Returns up to 10 books, each with its ShelfClub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, tags and shelfclub.app link.

id.description: The ShelfClub id of the book, as the other tools return it.

tools.name: get_trending_books
tools.description: List the books trending on ShelfClub: the books its readers have been shelving come first, then the catalog's most widely read books. Returns up to 10 books, each with its ShelfClub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and mood, vibe and pace tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book).

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Look up an author in the ShelfClub catalog by ShelfClub author id, which get_book returns for the authors of a book. Returns the author's name, biography, birth and death dates and shelfclub.app link. With `include_books`, also returns up to 10 of their books, the most recently published first, each with its ShelfClub id, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and mood, vibe, pace and genre tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book).

id.description: The ShelfClub id of the author, from the `authorLinks` of a get_book result.

include_books.description: Also return up to 10 of the author's books.
